tool_version: Pinned IDA 9.5 ASM and Hex-Rays C; iced-x86 1.21.0, pefile 2024.8.26, Zig 0.13.0
command: Decode original instructions at the pinned IDA addresses; reassemble with python verify.py <zedstwu.dll> <zig>. Run check-native-coverage.py NATIVE-350 --original <zedstwu.dll>.
scope: Legacy entries, original entry point, exports, all runtime anchors and the additional direct branch target at RVA 0x180c0; two copy entries, 128 import thunks and version resource checked independently. Fifth-round evidence includes four reassembled business exports and a cross-DLL data symbol.
limitations: The remaining coverage gaps require per-function control flow, ABI and data recovery. Indirect transfers outside the recovered copy path require further binding. Static verification only.
